chunk_content: support system to modern psychiatry is the need of the hou\ r The principles yurvedic Psychiatry revolves around the concept mutual inter relationship between the activities of daily life. The structural and functional components of the body viz, Dosha, Dhatu, Mala and Ojas Ahara and ihara which becomes the determinants of health and ill health. Reciprocally the status of \221Satva\222 is also indispensably fected these factors. The current statistics of psychiatric disorders also depicts the haphazardness of diet and regimen of modern life.
